redundancy.overlap_warning: Pair contribution ratios overlap if the same token appears in multiple pairs; do not sum all rows.

definitions.all_tokens_scope: mean/variance/std use all265; train_* moments and every label-based statistic use train185 only
definitions.eta_floating_boundary: Only absolute roundoff <=1e-12 near 0 or 1 is represented as that boundary; values outside [0,1] beyond that tolerance raise ArithmeticError. Raw variance and SS values are unchanged.
definitions.adjusted_eta_squared: 1-(1-eta_squared)*(n-1)/(n-g); may be negative, null if n<=g or total_SS=0; not a significance test
definitions.distance_contribution_ratio: train_variance_j/sum_j(train_variance_j); undefined null if all dimensions have zero variance
definitions.pattern_C: Descriptive intersection of variance>=within-levelQ75 and eta<=within-levelMedian, no token selection/removal
definitions.statistical_selection: No stopwords selected; patterns and categories are descriptive review aids only

oov.fraction_denominator: all test tokens before vocabulary filtering = represented TF + ignored TF

top20.composition_denominator: Number of actually transmitted token coordinates, not sum of frequency values or API tokens
top20.value_sum_note: B is a rounded regression estimate and C is a true count. Value sums are not API token usage and do not measure information value.
top20.historical_audit_limit: A/B requests were reconstructed and exact-input-verified; C also has contemporaneous SDK capture. No new SDK calls were made.
top20.interpretation_limit: Role labels and coordinate proportions describe the old inputs; they do not establish causal hint usefulness or invalidate alternative correct solutions.
